name: Flagon of the Tavern Fray
body:
Aura faint abjuration and conjuration; CL 10th; Slot shield; Price 62,700 gp; Weight — (empty)

DESCRIPTION

This large fair wood mug is carved with cheerful verses from tavern songs and drinking scenes. When the flagon is full of alcohol, it can be used as a +2 singing light wooden shield. Three times per day, on command, the bearer or another creature can drink an alcoholic beverage from it to receive the benefits of neutralize poison. Lastly, any poison poured into the flagon is permanently transformed into a delicious liquor, as for pick your poison.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 31,350 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wondrous Item; Spells neutralize poison, pick your poison, shield
